name: SousShift AI
facts: SousShift AI (say it 'SOO-shift', like sous chef) builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses.
Customers scan a QR code and the app opens in their phone browser. There is nothing to download and no account to make.
Plans are per restaurant: Basic $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth $3,500 setup + $650/mo, Done-for-you $4,000 setup + $950/mo.

Every plan has a branded app, ordering, a QR at every table, a 4K photo menu with 3D dishes, a menu in 12 languages, points, rewards and visit levels, invite-a-friend referrals, a custom game, a free daily spin, a weekly leaderboard and giveaway, a customer list, and hosting and support.
Growth adds Google review prompts, nearby/GPS alerts, the AI Text Assistant, automatic bring-back texts, missed-call text-back, and we place your print order.
Done-for-you adds the AI Voice Host and we run your texting and marketing.
AI Text Assistant is $75/mo per location and is included in Growth and Done-for-you.
AI Voice Host + Text is $150/mo per location and is included in Done-for-you. It includes the Text Assistant.
Online Ordering + Delivery add-on is $300/mo flat, or $200/mo + 5% of the food on each order. It is coming soon, with pickup first. DoorDash delivery waits on DoorDash approval.
Social & SEO Growth is $1,000/mo. The Everything bundle (Done-for-you + Social & SEO) is $4,000 setup + $1,800/mo.
Sports Bar Package, Games Pack and 3D Digital Menu are add-ons priced by quote. Ask us.
Three ways to pay the setup: in full, split 50/50 (half at signing, half when your app is delivered), or flexible, from $750 down with the rest spread over 12 months and no extra charge.
There is a 3-month minimum, then month to month. Either side can cancel with 30 days' written notice, and email counts. AI add-ons are month to month from day one.
Your customer list is yours, with CSV export anytime.
Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo.
The free sample takes about 3 minutes to request. Antidote reviews it personally and usually builds it the same day. No card, no pressure.
Contact: secondshiftai@gmail.com, Instagram @SousShiftAi, or the 24/7 AI sales line (424) 296-3303.
The sales line is answered by Nia, SousShift's AI guide. Nia explains plans and add-ons, answers questions and connects callers to Antidote. It takes calls only, and texts to it don't work yet.
Demo apps: Melody Bar & Grill, Nalu Vida, Gritz N Wafflez, StormBurger, Churrito Loco, Lucky Dragon, an ice cream truck app, a food truck app, an auto shop app and a gym app.
Melody Bar & Grill is our first onboarded partner and is going live now. The other demos are samples that show what we build.
Truck plans: Single Scoop $99 then $29/mo, Double Scoop $299 (or $199 for the first 10 trucks) then $50/mo, Sundae $599 then $129/mo for up to 3 trucks. No contract.
Websites for any business: Basic Care $1,500 + $99/mo, Full Care $1,500 + $199/mo, Own It $2,500 one time.
The app works with any register (Toast, Square, Clover and others). Nothing to install.
The app and staff app come in English and Spanish, and the menu comes in 12 languages.
Results are not guaranteed. Any sales figures are estimates, not promises.
Prices are for new clients. Existing clients keep their signed deals.

qa.a: SousShift AI builds branded apps, custom games and rewards for restaurants and local businesses. Guests scan a QR, play your game, join your rewards and come back.
It's 'SOO-shift', like sous chef.
Restaurants, bars, cafés, food trucks and ice cream trucks, plus mechanics, barbershops, salons, gyms, car washes and retail shops. We build the app and game to fit your business.
Per restaurant: Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo, Growth is $3,500 + $650/mo, and Done-for-you is $4,000 + $950/mo. Add-ons are priced separately.
Three: Basic (start here), Growth (most popular) and Done-for-you (sit back). Each one builds on the one before it.

Basic is $3,000 setup + $350/mo. You get a branded app with ordering and a table QR, a 4K photo menu with 3D dishes, a menu in 12 languages, points and rewards, referrals, a custom game with a daily spin and weekly leaderboard, your customer list, a print kit, a promo video, and hosting and support. You send your own texts and promotions.

Growth is $3,500 setup + $650/mo. It has everything in Basic plus Google review prompts, nearby/GPS alerts, the AI Text Assistant, automatic birthday and win-back texts, missed-call text-back, and we place your print order.
Done-for-you is $4,000 setup + $950/mo. It has everything in Growth plus the AI Voice Host that answers your phone, and we run your texting and marketing for you. You approve, we do the work.

Basic if you're happy to send your own texts and print your own stickers. Growth if you want guests brought back automatically. Done-for-you if you want to sit back while we run the marketing and answer the phone.

qa.q: What's the cheapest way to start?
qa.a: Basic is the lowest plan at $3,000 setup + $350/mo. You can also request a free sample first, with no card.

qa.q: What do I have to do on each plan?
qa.a: Basic: you send your own texts and promotions and print the stickers using our files. Growth: bring-back texts run on their own and we order your printing. Done-for-you: we run the texting and marketing.

qa.q: What's included and what costs extra?
qa.a: Everything listed in your plan is included. Extras are the AI Voice Host (on Basic and Growth), the Text Assistant on Basic, Online Ordering + Delivery, Social & SEO, the Sports Bar Package, Games Pack and 3D Digital Menu.

AI Text Assistant $75/mo, AI Voice Host + Text $150/mo, Online Ordering + Delivery $300/mo (coming soon), Social & SEO Growth $1,000/mo, plus Sports Bar Package, Games Pack and 3D Digital Menu by quote.

Two options: the AI Text Assistant at $75/mo and the AI Voice Host + Text at $150/mo, both per location. They answer your customers 24/7 with your real hours, menu and specials, and hand anything they can't handle to you.

qa.q: What does the AI Text Assistant cost and do?
qa.a: $75/mo per location, and it's included in Growth and Done-for-you. Guests text your number and an AI answers 24/7 about hours, menu, specials, reservation requests and catering, and it texts back anyone whose call you missed.

qa.q: What does the AI Voice Host cost and do?
qa.a: $150/mo per location, included in Done-for-you. A natural AI voice answers your phone 24/7 or after hours, takes reservation requests, transfers to staff and texts links, and it includes the Text Assistant.

qa.q: How many texts and minutes are included?
qa.a: The Text Assistant includes 1,000 texts a month, then $0.03 a text. The Voice Host + Text includes 750 call minutes and 1,000 texts a month, then $0.15 a minute and $0.03 a text.

qa.q: Does the AI sound like a robot?
qa.a: It uses a natural, modern AI voice and you can try it yourself. It says it's an AI if asked and never pretends to be a person.

qa.q: Can I hear the AI voice host?
qa.a: Yes. There are demo voice hosts: Kira for Melody Bar & Grill and Kai for Nalu Vida, and you talk to them right in your browser. They don't take real orders or reservations.

qa.q: What if the AI doesn't know the answer?
qa.a: It doesn't guess. It tells the customer a person will follow up and texts you or your manager the question with the customer's name and number.
It collects reservation requests (name, party size, date, time, phone) and sends them to your staff to confirm. It doesn't book into your system on its own.

qa.q: What phone number does the AI use?
qa.a: Your existing number through call forwarding, which we walk you through, or a new local number we set up for you.

qa.q: How long does the AI take to set up?
qa.a: We load your hours, menu, specials and FAQs, then test it with you. Texting needs carrier registration, which usually takes a few days. We handle that and tell you when it's live.

qa.q: Are the AI add-ons a contract?
qa.a: No. They're month to month per location, and you can switch tiers or cancel anytime.

Yes. Promotional texts go only to people who opted in, every one includes STOP to opt out, and nothing promotional goes out during quiet hours (we send 8 AM to 9 PM). We handle the carrier registration.

qa.q: Can customers order in the app?
qa.a: Yes. Every plan includes ordering and a table QR so guests can send their order from their seat. A separate Online Ordering + Delivery add-on with card payment is coming soon.

qa.q: What's the Online Ordering + Delivery add-on?
qa.a: Guests order and pay by card in your app, pickup first, with points on every order and live orders in your back office. It's $300/mo flat or $200/mo + 5% of the food, and it's coming soon.
Delivery through DoorDash drivers is planned once DoorDash approves our access, which is under review. It isn't live yet, so we'd go over it on a call.

qa.q: Is there a fee on each order?
qa.a: On the ordering add-on you can choose $300/mo flat with no per-order fee, or $200/mo + 5% of the food only (a $40 order = $2). Never on tips, tax or delivery fees, and nothing is added to your guests' checks.

qa.q: What is the Sports Bar Package?
qa.a: An add-on with live local scores, follow-your-team alerts, Fan Test, Football Squares, fight nights, pick-the-winner points and score specials. It's priced by quote, so ask us.
An add-on with trivia, sports trivia, a daily word game, word scramble and bar-safe Truth or Dare. Guests earn points for playing. It's priced by quote.

qa.q: What is the 3D Digital Menu add-on?
qa.a: Guests spin real 3D models of your signature dishes, with slow-motion food clips and a real-photo mode. It's priced by quote.

An optional $1,000/mo add-on: a content plan, short-form videos from your food, posting on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, Google Business Profile and local SEO, and a monthly report. We don't guarantee follower or view counts.
Done-for-you plus Social & SEO Growth together: $4,000 setup + $1,800/mo, which saves $150 a month.
Yes, for any business. It's a fast, phone-first site of up to 5 pages, ready in 7-10 days with 2 rounds of changes. Online stores or more than 5 pages are quoted.
Basic Care is $1,500 + $99/mo, Full Care is $1,500 + $199/mo, and Own It is $2,500 one time with no monthly fee. The care plans have a 3-month minimum.

qa.q: What's the difference between the website options?
qa.a: Basic Care keeps it online with up to 2 small edits a month. Full Care fixes anything and has unlimited small edits. Own It is one payment with the site and domain yours and 30 days of fixes.

Yes: AI chat box $49/mo, menu search $150, booking requests $250, 12 languages $250, Google reviews $100, email and text signup $150, gallery + promo video $200, extra page $150, logo design $300, and AI phone host + texting $150/mo.

qa.q: How can I pay for the setup?
qa.a: Three ways: all at signing, split 50/50 (half at signing and half when your app is delivered), or flexible from $750 down with the rest spread over 12 months.

qa.q: How does the flexible payment plan work?
qa.a: Put at least $750 down. The rest of the setup is split into 12 equal pieces added to your monthly, then it drops back to normal, with no extra charge. For example, Basic with $750 down is $537.50/mo for 12 months, then $350.
Yes. Pay 50% when you sign and 50% when your app is delivered (Go-Live).

qa.q: Can I pay everything up front?
qa.a: Yes. You can pay the setup in full by card at signing, then the monthly begins.

qa.q: When does the monthly fee start?
qa.a: The monthly starts the day you sign.
There's a 3-month minimum, then it's month to month. You can cancel with 30 days' written notice, and email counts.
After the 3-month minimum, yes, with 30 days' written notice. AI add-ons are month to month from day one, and your customer list goes with you.

qa.q: Does the monthly price go down?
qa.a: Yes, with the loyalty price. Your monthly drops $2 for every month you stay, up to $50 off. Basic goes $350, $348, $346 and down to $300. If you cancel and come back, it starts over.

If in your first 3 months after Go-Live there's no 30-day period where the app brought back at least 30 tracked return visits, your next 2 monthly payments are waived. It's a results promise, not a sales guarantee.

In any month your app customers spend more than $3,000 on food and non-alcoholic drinks, we get 10% of only the amount over $3,000. For example, $5,000 in app sales is $200. Under $3,000, nothing extra is owed.
You do. You get access and CSV export anytime, and a full export if you ever leave. We never sell it or use it for another business.

Tell us about your business, we build a sample with your real menu and photos, and you see it on your phone. If you go ahead, we build your app with your logo, colors, a game made for your food, and the rewards you choose. Then QR codes go on your tables and window.
Most restaurants go live within a couple of weeks of getting us the menu, photos and logo.

qa.q: How do I get a free sample?
qa.a: Fill out the short form (about 3 minutes) with your business type, a few items and prices, and 2-6 photos. Antidote reviews it personally, usually builds it the same day, and you see it on your phone. No card needed.

qa.q: How do I book a call or get a demo?
qa.a: Request a free sample, email secondshiftai@gmail.com, DM @SousShiftAi on Instagram, or call (424) 296-3303 any time and Nia will connect you to Antidote.

qa.q: Can I just talk to someone?
qa.a: Yes. Call (424) 296-3303 any time, 24/7. Nia, SousShift's AI guide, explains the plans and add-ons, answers your questions and connects you to Antidote.
Not yet. The (424) 296-3303 line takes calls only, and texts to it don't work. You can also email secondshiftai@gmail.com or DM @SousShiftAi.

qa.a: Your custom game has a weekly prize board. Players try to hit the high score, and the top score wins a prize you choose, then the board resets for the next week.

qa.q: Is it coming to the App Store?

qa.q: Does it work with Toast or Square?
